title: AI PPT
priceInactive: {{price}} credits per deck · free right now

input.title: What should the deck be about?
input.lead: Start with an idea or your own material. Shape the outline, then choose a look for your slides.
input.optionsLead: Add a use case, audience or writing preferences when you need them.

placeholders.topic: e.g. AI trends in the workplace for 2026
placeholders.text: Paste the source material you want turned into slides…

input.uploadHint: Drop a file here or choose one (up to {{mb}} MB)
input.uploadTypes: Word, PDF, text, Markdown or an existing presentation.
input.priceHint: Review the outline first. Generating the deck costs {{price}} credits.
input.freeHint: Review the outline, then choose a template. This generation is free.
input.freeHintPriced: Generating a deck is free on this deployment (the configured standard price is {{price}} credits per deck).

examples.label: Try one of these
examples.one: AI trends in the workplace for 2026

defaultTemplate.label: Default template
defaultTemplate.hint: Used when you pick nothing later. You can change it after the outline.

input.uploadTooLarge: Files must be no larger than {{mb}} MB

outline.title: Outline
outline.placeholder: The outline will stream in here, and you can edit it before rendering.
outline.rewriteLead: Describe the change and the model rewrites the whole outline.
outline.rewritePlaceholder: e.g. make the structure follow the pyramid principle
outline.waiting: The model is thinking — the outline will appear here as it is written.

template.title: Choose a template
template.lead: Pick the look of every slide.
template.renameLead: Only the display name changes; the template itself stays as it is.
template.deleteBody: It disappears from “Mine”. Decks you already generated are not affected.

result.previewLead: The rendered deck, as saved in your files.
result.previewFailed: This deck could not be previewed
result.mirrorPending: The file is not saved in your files yet. Retry the save.
result.changeTemplateLead: Re-render this deck with another template.
result.previewScrollHint: Scroll to page through every slide.

decks.emptyHint: Generated decks appear here, together with the .pptx saved in your files.
decks.deleteBody: The deck record and the .pptx saved in your files are both removed. This cannot be undone.
decks.lead: Open a finished presentation or pick up where you left off.

insufficient.title: Not enough credits
insufficient.description: This action costs {{price}} credits and you have {{available}} available. Top up to continue.

unconfigured.title: AI PPT is not configured
unconfigured.description: An administrator must add the Docmee API key under Admin → Capabilities & integrations → AI PPT before it becomes available.

permissionDenied.title: AI PPT is unavailable here
permissionDenied.description: Ask an administrator to review your group, workspace and member permissions.

disabled.title: AI PPT is turned off
disabled.description: An administrator has disabled AI PPT for this deployment.

loadFailed.title: Could not load AI PPT
loadFailed.description: The AI PPT configuration could not be loaded.

errors.upstream: The presentation service reported an error

editor.title: Edit presentation
editor.lead: Editing happens in the Docmee editor; closing it saves the file back to your files.
editor.failed: The editor could not be opened.
editor.synced: The edited file was saved to your files
editor.syncFailed: The edited file could not be saved to your files

render.title: Building “{{subject}}”
render.lead: Your slides are being laid out and prepared. The preview will appear when they are ready.
